Moominvalley: The Activity Book

A fun and engaging activity book bursting with the creativity and magic of the Moomins, Moominvalley: The Activity Book is perfect for Moomin fans of all ages.

All the activities in this easy-to-use activity handbook will inspire creativity and encourage you to always see the beauty in the world around you – just as the Moomins do.
